subject: Private maintenance: proposed windows, pin thresholds and network reroute approval
messages:
From: Alice Cho <ops-manager@crestbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Upcoming quarterly security patches — CrestBank private deployment

Hi Hannah,

We're lining up our quarterly security patch window for the on-prem Redwood Private deployment (rack 7 / VPC-crest-prod). Security wants the service to be updated to the 1.4.x stream and mentions that the infosec audit will check our pinning/rollback controls are documented.

Can you confirm:
- What maintenance windows you can support (weekend vs weekday narrow window)?
- Your pin policy (how long you'll hold a pinned version before allowlisting an upgrade)?
- Precise rollback timing and whether you can do an automated network reroute/drain to the standby cluster?

We need these details to run the change board on June 28.

Thanks,
Alice Cho
Infrastructure Manager — CrestBank
ops-manager@crestbank.com

Attachment: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Cho <ops-manager@crestbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Upcoming quarterly security patches — CrestBank private deployment

Alice — thanks for the heads up. Below is a concise ops plan we can run through the change board; I've attached the pin policy excerpt and our drain checklist for the network team. If you want, we can walk the board through this on a 15-minute call.

Summary (proposal):
- Preferred maintenance window: Saturday 00:00–04:00 local (low traffic). We can do a weekday narrow window (Tue 02:00–04:00) if wider business SLA demands it.
- Version pin policy: we will pin the minor version for 72 hours post-rollout by default (example: 1.4.2 -> pin to 1.4.x for 72h). If you request longer quarantine we can extend to 7 days with an SLA exception (requires approval). Pin policy doc attached (rdw_pin_policy_v2.pdf).
- Canary + roll schedule: 10% canary for 2 hours, expand to 50% for 1 hour, then full ramp if metrics remain healthy.
- Abort/rollback thresholds (initial):
  * error rate increase > 2.5 percentage points vs baseline over 15m
  * 99th percentile token latency increase > 180ms vs baseline over 15m
  * KV cache miss spike > 20% sustained for 10m
  * Any critical customer-facing outage observed
- Rollback timing: automated failover can complete within 8–12 minutes (endpoint-level swap and KV cache flush), manual rollback will be staged if automation fails.
- Network reroute/drain: we'll instruct our edge layer to stop new sessions to the target fleet and BGP announce the standby prefix; expected additional propagation time is ~2–6 minutes depending on your upstreams. Network checklist attached (net-drain-checklist.xlsx).
- Preflight tests: smoke generation, KV warmup script, and a short load soak (5m at 15% traffic) prior to canary.

Notes & approvals needed from CrestBank:
1) Confirm maintenance window selection (Sat 00–04 or Tue 02–04).
2) Decide on pin quarantine length (72h default vs 7d extended).
3) If extended pin required, confirm the SLA-exception link so we can route approvals: https://app.redwood.ai/sla-exceptions/REQ-5482

If internal infra wants to bump the abort thresholds tighter (e.g., 2% error rate), let us know — Karthik and Soojin are looped for the technical detail.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments: rdw_pin_policy_v2.pdf (policy excerpt), net-drain-checklist.xlsx (network steps & BGP playbook)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Alice Cho <ops-manager@crestbank.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Upcoming quarterly security patches — CrestBank private deployment

Looping in the technical constraints so the change board has something concrete. Quick bullet list of specifics we'll run: 

Preflight (30–60m before canary):
- Run smoke cohort against standby cluster (connectivity, auth, basic LLM inference).
- Warm KV cache using the recorded prefix sequences (script: warm_kv_crest.sh). Expect 10–12m to reach steady-state.
- Run token-level throughput check at 20% normal load for 5m.

Canary sequence (automation):
1) Deploy binary -> run topology health checks -> run smoke tests (3m)
2) Edge gating: route 10% sessions to canary via our routing tier. Monitor metrics for 120m.
3) If stable, expand to 50% for 60m; then full ramp (20m ramp window).

Rollback choreography:
- Automated rollback action is a traffic swap to pinned control plane followed by incremental reversion of serving nodes. That swap is triggered when the alerting threshold crosses 3 of the abort signals in <30m. Service-level revert completes within 8–12m in our lab tests.
- Manual rollback command is: /ops/revert --target-version 1.4.1 --evict-kv true --drain-new-sessions true. Use only if automation fails.

Network re-route specifics (for your network team):
- On our side: withdraw target prefixes, BGP announce standby prefix.
- Expect propagation variance; please coordinate with your upstreams for a planned 10-minute window to reduce AS path churn.

Telemetry & acceptance:
- We will take a final sign-off 30m after full ramp (ops + your network + security).

Open items for the board:
- Agree abort triggers (Hannah proposed 2.5 percentage points error increase). I recommend 3% to reduce false positives for noisy endpoints.
- Decide pin quarantine length (72h v 7d).

Happy to present this to the board or record a short run-through video.

—Kar
Karthik Iyer
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Upcoming quarterly security patches — CrestBank private deployment

Thanks all — quick decision: I approve the canary sequencing and preflight items. One small tweak request for the board: change the error-rate abort trigger down to 2.0 percentage points (from baseline) and keep the latency threshold at 180ms. The KV-miss threshold looks fine.

If CrestBank wants an extended pin (7d) we'll route the SLA exception; if they keep 72h default, no extra paperwork.

+1 on a short walk-through call for the change board.

Soojin Lee
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference

Hannah / team — this is perfect, thank you. CrestBank change board approved the Saturday 00:00–04:00 window and the 72h pin quarantine. We accept the abort triggers with Soojin's tweak (2.0% error delta).

We'll have our network team on the bridge for BGP announcements and will post the upstream contact list prior to the window. I'll also pre-approve the automated rollback path so your automation can run without manual blocks; procurement confirms no SLA exception needed for 72h.

I'll schedule the 15m alignment call for Friday at 10:00 AM ET to walk through the runbook and the attachments — please include the warm_kv_crest.sh in the shared runbook.

Thanks again,
Alice Cho
